news.title: Kevin Warsh hearing takeaways: Trump Fed chair nominee defends finances, says president never demanded rate cuts
news.description: Fed chair nominee Kevin Warsh's confirmation hearing before the Senate Banking Committee will bring questions about interest rates and his personal wealth.

news.title: Trump says 'I'll remember' companies that don’t seek tariff refunds
news.description: Trump said he was "not happy with the Supreme Court" for ruling IEEPA tariffs were illegal, and for not allowing the U.S. to keep tariffs already collected.
